CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_session_xp(p_xp integer, p_level text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_avatar_url text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_level text := case
    when p_level in ('A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2', 'C1', 'C2') then p_level
    else null
  end;
  v_name text;
  v_avatar text;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'record_session_xp requires an authenticated user';
  end if;
  if p_xp is null or p_xp <= 0 or p_xp > 100000 then
    return;
  end if;

  select nullif(username, ''), avatar_url
  into v_name, v_avatar
  from public.profiles
  where id = v_user;

  -- Profil vyhráva; klient (OAuth full_name) sa použije len keď profil
  -- ešte nemá username. Nikdy neprepíšeme uložený nickname.
  v_name := coalesce(v_name, nullif(p_name, ''), 'Player');
  v_avatar := coalesce(v_avatar, p_avatar_url);

  insert into public.leaderboard (
    user_id, name, xp, avatar_url, active_cefr_level,
    xp_a1, xp_a2, xp_b1, xp_b2, xp_c1, xp_c2
  )
  values (
    v_user,
    v_name,
    p_xp,
    v_avatar,
    coalesce(v_level, 'A1'),
    case when coalesce(v_level, 'A1') = 'A1' then p_xp else 0 end,
    case when v_level = 'A2' then p_xp else 0 end,
    case when v_level = 'B1' then p_xp else 0 end,
    case when v_level = 'B2' then p_xp else 0 end,
    case when v_level = 'C1' then p_xp else 0 end,
    case when v_level = 'C2' then p_xp else 0 end
  )
  on conflict (user_id) do update set
    xp = public.leaderboard.xp + excluded.xp,
    name = excluded.name,
    avatar_url = coalesce(excluded.avatar_url, public.leaderboard.avatar_url),
    active_cefr_level = coalesce(v_level, public.leaderboard.active_cefr_level),
    xp_a1 = public.leaderboard.xp_a1 + excluded.xp_a1,
    xp_a2 = public.leaderboard.xp_a2 + excluded.xp_a2,
    xp_b1 = public.leaderboard.xp_b1 + excluded.xp_b1,
    xp_b2 = public.leaderboard.xp_b2 + excluded.xp_b2,
    xp_c1 = public.leaderboard.xp_c1 + excluded.xp_c1,
    xp_c2 = public.leaderboard.xp_c2 + excluded.xp_c2;
end;
$function$
